crossRefs.note: You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I didn’t understand…
This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.

translations.web: “There are three things which are too amazing for me, four which I don’t understand:
translations.bsb: There are three things too wonderful for me, four that I cannot understand:
translations.kjv: There be three things which are too wonderful for me, yea, four which I know
translations.asv: There are three things which are too wonderful for me, Yea, four which I know not:
